title: 建立 Core 可运行工程骨架与运行纵向链路
objective: 建立可独立安装、构建、启动和验证的 Core NestJS/Prisma 底层骨架，形成配置到数据库 readiness、OIDC 验证边界和可观测性的最小运行链路。
in_scope: NestJS 模块化单体工程、严格 TypeScript、lint、format、Vitest 和依赖边界
启动配置 Schema、结构化日志、OpenTelemetry 初始化与私有 liveness/readiness
Core PostgreSQL/Prisma 基线、受控迁移命令和数据库 readiness
可替换 OIDC token verifier 端口与本地 issuer/JWKS 边界测试
容器构建、自部署运行输入和无生产值的配置示例
修正 Contracts Redocly 多 binary 启动命令并保持契约内容不变
out_of_scope: 公共 Profile、Developer App、PAT、角色、额度、积分、审计或 outbox 业务实现
Keycloak realm、Compose、Nginx、正式域名、生产环境和真实秘密
Community、Skin、消费者或 TypeScript SDK 开发
公共 OpenAPI、Schema、事件、OAuth scope、错误语义或版本修改
contract_impact: none; mc-plan-contracts changes are limited to executable validation command documentation
acceptance_evidence: Core installs with a frozen lockfile and provides real lint, format, typecheck, unit, integration, migration, contract-readonly, build, and end-to-end commands
The application starts with validated configuration and exposes dependency-free liveness plus PostgreSQL-and-migration-aware readiness
OIDC verifier tests reject unknown issuer, wrong audience, expired tokens, and unverified email while accepting a valid locally signed token
Prisma validation and an isolated PostgreSQL migration/readiness test pass without accessing any other service database
Structured logging, OpenTelemetry initialization, container build inputs, and rollback constraints are documented and testable
Contracts Python and Redocly validation pass with the corrected documented launcher
